stage: prototype; three-person validation pending; Unity integration not implemented
coordinateSystem: mirrored image, x right, y down

parameters.label: Landmark confidence
parameters.meaning: Minimum visibility and presence for required joints.

parameters.label: Boundary margin
parameters.meaning: Fraction of image width excluded on each side of section dividers.

parameters.label: Calibration duration (s)
parameters.meaning: All three regions must stay visible for this long.

parameters.label: Low hand height
parameters.meaning: (Shoulder Y − average wrist Y) / shoulder width. Maps to zero throttle.

parameters.label: High hand height
parameters.meaning: Same normalized measurement. Maps to full throttle.

parameters.label: Minimum travel speed (units/s)
parameters.meaning: Preview travel speed at zero throttle while tracked.

parameters.label: Maximum travel speed (units/s)
parameters.meaning: Preview travel speed at full throttle. Units are test-world units.

parameters.label: Hand height to turn
parameters.meaning: Raised wrist above its shoulder, divided by shoulder width; mirrored screen-left hand turns left.

parameters.label: Hand height to rearm
parameters.meaning: Both wrists must return below this normalized height before another turn.

parameters.label: Lane transition time (s)
parameters.meaning: How quickly the preview moves into the next lane.

parameters.label: Both-hand height to jump
parameters.meaning: Each wrist must be this far above its own shoulder, divided by shoulder width.

parameters.label: Both-hand height to rearm jump
parameters.meaning: Both wrists must lower below this shoulder-relative height after the animation lands before another jump.

parameters.label: Hand distance to grab
parameters.meaning: Wrist distance divided by shoulder width. A grab triggers when hands move from apart to this distance or closer.

parameters.label: Hand distance to rearm grab
parameters.meaning: Separate wrists to at least this normalized distance before another grab.

parameters.label: Minimum time between grabs (s)
parameters.meaning: Reject another grab until this time has elapsed and hands have separated.

parameters.label: Air time (s)
parameters.meaning: Duration of one fixed parabolic jump.

parameters.label: Peak jump height (units)
parameters.meaning: Peak height of the preview jump in test-world units.
